workflow: Built-in ImageGen border-only edits on seven simple card backs; themed corners and restrained bands, central emblems retained

items.name: 行囊粗布
items.imagegen_prompt: BORDER-DESIGN EDIT. Input 1 is the CURRENT simplified card back and is the edit target. Preserve its sole central emblem, silhouette, object count, placement, scale, palette and calm background as closely as possible. Do not redesign the central illustration. Inputs 2,3,4 are PROJECT CARD ART STYLE references only for large opaque color masses, broad directional strokes, hard grouped shadows and economical material drawing. Do not copy their weapons, slash beams or chest. Replace the plain thin rectangular gold outline with a DISTINCTIVE BUT RESTRAINED THEMED CARD-BACK FRAME. Keep the overall set coherent: the new enclosing frame uses a dark outer binding band, a clear inner boundary and four purposeful corner shapes. All FOUR sides and FOUR corners remain complete. The frame occupies roughly 6% of canvas width at left/right and similar substantial painted thickness at top/bottom. Decorations stay inside that border band and do not spread into the central picture. A readable frame silhouette and a few thematic shapes matter more than ornamental detail. A weathered ochre canvas binding frame with a dark slate outer edge and a narrow darker inner seam. Four broad folded-cloth triangular corner overlaps, each with only two large cream stitches. The side bands remain calm and plain. Shape the binding with a few broad cloth shadow planes; no fabric pattern, winding rope or extra center objects. STYLE: match the existing project's low-detail hand-painted anime artwork. Complete clear shapes, connected matte opaque color planes, a few broad shadow turns, wide strokes and restrained highlights. Keep the long edge surfaces calm, preserve generous quiet space in the center and avoid covering surfaces with texture. No dense micro-pattern, all-over scratches, fine engraving, jewellery clutter, thin decorative line networks, glossy 3D, photoreal materials, words, letters, numbers, logos or UI. Single portrait 2:3 front-on artwork, full bleed, no mockup, tabletop or outside margin. Change the border only; preserve the central simple emblem.
